environments.title: Environments
environments.subtitle: An environment is what a task's desktop comes with. Everyone on the team can start tasks from these.
environments.empty: No environments. Add one and tasks can start from it.

editor.name: Name
editor.appsHint: Each one gets a button on the desktop's panel.
editor.advancedHint: For a project that needs its code, tools and keys in place before the agent starts.
editor.repositoryHint: Cloned when the desktop is made. For a private GitHub repository, add a variable named GITHUB_TOKEN.
editor.setupScriptHint: Runs once on a new desktop, in a terminal you can watch, in the repository's folder when there is one.
editor.variablesHint: Set in every shell on the desktop and given to the agent. Values are stored protected and never shown again.
editor.instructionsHint: Added to what the agent is told on every desktop made from this environment.
editor.instructionsPlaceholder: Run the tests before you say you are done. Leave the app running on port 3000.
editor.deleteBody: Tasks can no longer start from it. Tasks already started from it must be deleted first.

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Everyone on a team can see, use and manage every task and environment in it.
team.name: Team name
team.removeBody: They lose access to this team's tasks and environments at once.
team.leaveBody: You lose access to its tasks and environments.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.linkBody: Send {email} this link. It works once, and only for that address.
invite.emailedBody: We emailed {email} an invitation. You can also send them this link yourself. It works once, and only for that address.

team.adminOnly: Only an administrator can invite people or change who is on the team.

email.title: Email
email.taskEmails: Email me when a task I started or wrote in is finished or needs me
email.taskEmailsHint: Not while you have its desktop on screen, and at most once every ten minutes for each task. This is your own setting and applies on every team you are on.

usage.title: Usage
usage.subtitle: What this team has used since {date}.

models.title: Models
models.body: What the team's agents have spent on AI models this month. When the allowance is used up, agents stop until next month or until it is raised.

desktops.title: Desktops
desktops.hours: {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} of desktop time
desktops.body: A desktop counts from when it starts until it stops. Idle desktops stop by themselves.
